measurement_rule: Use one copy per episode and 24h or 72h observation. Unknown remains null, never zero. This file does not collect data or install tracking.

metric_units.rates: ratio from 0 to 1, never mixed with percent from 0 to 100
metric_units.money: integer minor currency units; currency must be populated before recording money

business_intent.definition: A concrete commerce need/question about using the product; likes and generic comments are not inquiries.
business_intent.privacy_rule: Aggregate counts only. No account handles, emails, phone numbers, order bodies or comment transcripts.

attribution.rule: Do not attribute all website registrations/payments to Douyin or to one post. Evidence references must be safe aggregate receipts, not secret or customer records.

cash.rule: Only calculate net after both gross and refunds are known in the same currency/window/cohort. Net collections are not profit. No hypothetical earnings.
